title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mountain Winery, Saratoga | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mountain Winery in Saratoga, California, USA, on 14 June 2000.

It was the 22nd show by the sixth All-Starr Band, and the first of two consecutive nights in Saratoga. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr returned to the Mountain Winery on 24 July 2008, 3 August 2010, 17 July 2012, and 24 May 2024.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
